report_identity.report_title: China Hongguang Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The Group manufactures and sells glass products in the PRC, mainly energy-efficient safety glass and smart glass under the Hongguang brand.
business_overview.revenue_model: Direct sale of glass products to PRC customers; control transfers when goods are delivered to the customer location; normal credit term is 30 to 270 days.
business_notes: All revenue is generated from sales of glass products in the PRC.
The Group is transforming coated glass products toward optoelectronic applications, but 2025 revenue remains mainly energy-efficient safety glass.

non_recurring_items.item: reversal of impairment losses on trade and bill receivables, net
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Reversal reduced G&A expense and inflated 2025 profit versus cash collection quality.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 p.56 and note 6(c), p.88

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Government grants included in other net income, not core product profit.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at banks and on hand; RMB not freely convertible and remittance out of Mainland China is subject to exchange restrictions.

operating_assets.business_substance: Raw materials and finished glass products.

operating_assets.item: trade and bill receivables and other receivables
operating_assets.business_substance: Customer credit and other operating receivables; net trade/bill receivables RMB207.428m, deposits/prepayments/other RMB84.275m.
PRC plant, buildings, machinery, equipment and construction in progress.

investment_assets.business_substance: Long-term equity interest in a private PRC entity, not short-term detachable cash.

other_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position p.53

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Secured bank loans within one year/on demand; guarantees by controlling family and some PPE security.
Secured sale-and-leaseback financing borrowings, current RMB1.725m and non-current RMB0.112m.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Trade payables, accruals, contract liabilities RMB4.923m and amount due to director RMB1.849m.

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position p.53

years.source: Annual Report 2025 comparative cash flow p.56
Annual Report 2024 cash flow as prior-year comparator; summarized in 2025 financial summary p.123 for profit

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 profit did not convert to operating cash because trade/bill and other receivables increased by RMB71.567m; the 3-year operating cash flow record is weak and volatile.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated profit or loss p.52 and note 4 p.86

evidence.note: RMB thousand; RMB exchange/remittance restriction note disclosed

gaps: Annual report does not split consolidated cash by listing-company parent, Hong Kong subsidiary and PRC operating subsidiary; company-level statement shows parent cash was nil at 2025 year-end.
No restricted cash line was found; cash note discloses RMB exchange/remittance restriction, so PRC cash haircut is required.

Cash flow statement does not show cash payment for PPE additions in 2025, although PPE note records RMB23.669m construction-in-progress additions; maintenance versus growth capex cannot be precisely split.
Only annual report 2025 was newly extracted in this run; 2023 cash flow facts are taken from prior-year comparator/summary rather than a full 2023 fact pack.
